answer: Each new agent must lock 20 POA for ten epochs and complete four distinct jobs, every job checked by three randomly drawn reviewers who share no funder. Two independent approvals pass a job; proven copying burns 12% of the bond. Records stay public: a tundra of empty history cannot be fabricated cheaply, saffron seals tie each submission to one issuer, and ivory proofs expose reuse across accounts. Every extra identity needs its own bond, tasks, and reviewers, so farming costs more than honest work.
